paragraphs: Specific Energy sells pump station control and analytics, and its site lists the Dynamic Pump Optimizer, the Lift Station Guardian and Tagger under Solutions. The listed address is 1978 South Austin Ave, Georgetown, TX 78626.

Product pages describe hardware with no moving parts, a 0-70℃ temperature rating and a 10-watt power requirement. Listed capabilities include cloud based configuration, control, and deployment, dashboards and control screens, and text message alerts. The security section says the company follows the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
A customer highlight points to Mustang SUD, and case studies cover Aqua WSC and the City of Chattanooga.

quote.text: We take the guesswork out of pump operations.
